message.content:
I don’t have real‑time data, but I can give you a quick overview of what you might expect in San Francisco:

| Season | Typical Weather |
|--------|-----------------|
| **Winter (Dec–Feb)** | Mild, average highs around 12–15 °C (54–59 °F). Rain is common, especially in December and January. |
| **Spring (Mar–May)** | Gradually warming, highs 15–20 °C (59–68 °F). Rain still possible, but days become sunnier. |
| **Summer (Jun–Aug)** | Cool and foggy, especially near the coast. Average highs 18–22 °C (64–72 °F). Inland areas can be warmer. |
| **Fall (Sep–Nov)** | Mild, highs 18–22 °C (64–72 °F). Fog and rain start to increase toward November. |

If you need the current forecast, you could check a reliable weather website or app (e.g., Weather.com, AccuWeather, or the National Weather Service). Let me know if you’d like a more detailed forecast for a specific date!
